From outcast undead Paladins to dwarves who channel the elements as Shamans, these are the six new Race & Class combos launching with World of Warcraft: Forever. Become an Orc Mage, Troll Warlock, Gnome Priest, or Human Hunter and experience this version of Azeroth from a totally new perspective.
